title: {{APP_TITLE}}: remediate unstable pods (approval required)
description: SCAFFOLD. Fires on a Davis availability problem. Works out whether the pods are being killed for memory (propose a higher memory limit) or started failing after a rollout (propose rolling back), asks a human to approve, then applies it through the Kubernetes Connector. Approve and apply are inactive; with them inactive a run only produces a plan.

eventTrigger.filterQuery: event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND event.status == "ACTIVE" AND matchesValue(event.status_transition, {"CREATED", "REOPENED"}) AND matchesValue(event.category, {"AVAILABILITY", "RESOURCE_CONTENTION"})

evidence.name: evidence
evidence.description: Per container in the app boundary: OOM kills, restarts and the newest pod start in the last 2 hours, with the current memory limit

input.query:
timeseries { oom=max(dt.kubernetes.container.oom_kills), rst=max(dt.kubernetes.container.restarts), lim=avg(dt.kubernetes.container.limits_memory), mem=avg(dt.kubernetes.container.memory_working_set) },
  by:{k8s.container.name, k8s.namespace.name, k8s.workload.name}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m
| filter k8s.namespace.name=="{{NAMESPACE}}"
| fieldsAdd oomMax=arrayMax(oom), restartsMax=arrayMax(rst), restartsMin=arrayMin(rst), memLimit=arrayAvg(lim), memPeak=arrayMax(mem)
| filter oomMax > 0 or restartsMax - restartsMin > 0
| fields container=k8s.container.name, workload=k8s.workload.name, oomMax, restarts=restartsMax-restartsMin, memLimit, memPeak
| sort restarts desc | limit 5

rollouts.name: rollouts
rollouts.description: Rollouts and spec changes in the last 2 hours

input.query:
fetch events, from:now()-2h
| filter k8s.namespace.name=="{{NAMESPACE}}" and event.kind=="DAVIS_EVENT"
| filter contains(event.name, "spec change") or in(dt.kubernetes.event.reason, array("ScalingReplicaSet","SuccessfulCreate"))
| summarize changes=count(), lastChange=max(timestamp), by:{workload=k8s.workload.name}

plan.name: plan
plan.description: Chooses between raising a memory limit, rolling back, or escalating to a human with no change

approve.name: approve
approve.description: TODO: choose approvers. Declined or timed-out approvals fail the workflow, so nothing is applied.

apply.name: apply
apply.description: TODO: select the Kubernetes connection and VERIFY the action ids in the Workflows UI (patch for a memory limit, rollout undo for a rollback). This is the only step that changes production.
